children.text: Gimetry Studio is a brand, web and motion design studio based in Johor Bahru, Malaysia.
We work across brand identity, web design and development, and motion — often all three on the same engagement.
Johor Bahru sits an hour from Singapore, and that shapes the work. Our clients run from Malaysian SMEs to regional operators, and a good number of projects cross the causeway.
Being small is the point. Projects run with the people who designed them still attached, which is why the work stays consistent from the first sketch to the last handover.
A typical engagement starts with the awkward questions — who is this actually for, what has to be true on day one, what breaks at scale — and the answers shape everything after.
We build systems rather than one-offs. A grid, a type scale, a set of reusable sections: the point is that the next page does not need us to redraw it.
Recent work spans robotics and AI infrastructure, fintech, industrial services, football and theme park campaigns. Different worlds, same method.
If you are working on something that needs to look like it means it, get in touch.
Gimetry Studio is based in Johor Bahru, Malaysia, and works with clients across Malaysia, Singapore and further afield.
What kind of work do you take on?
Design identity, web design and development, and motion design — including LED and event campaign visuals. Most projects combine at least two of the three.
With a short discovery conversation about audience, constraints and what success looks like. That shapes the scope before any design work begins.
